Background information: I've been using Slackware Linux exclusively for the past ~11 years.

My current setup:

  • sda1: ext2 (50MB): /boot
  • sda2 XFS (encrypted): /
  • sdb: 1.3TB (90% in use) "media" drive, (~4 years old)
  • sdb1 XFS (not encryped): Source repos, torrents, games, music, movies, etc.

I already have a 1TB backup drive (encrypted) that I use for semi-cold backups.

This drive is pretty fast. I tested it by formatting it as XFS (unencrypted) and it clocked at about 150 MiB/s read/write. Internal SATA2 drive (encrypted LUKS/XFS) tops out at around 130MiB/s.
